title: A Tatooine Skiff
section: The Merchandising Art of Star Wars
description: A Tatooine Skiff was supposed to take Luke to his final resting place, but he had other ideas. This preliminary, unattributed package art (front, collection of Thomas H. Neiheisel) shows how Kenner Products mastered the ability to simplify vehicles from the trilogy, yet make them appear similar to the masterful props built by Industrial Light & Magic.
